I’ve had terrible treatment from my previous GP. Like awful! Treated like an idiot, treated so poorly and with no empathy, nhs England advice ignored. So when I joined Alcester Health Centre this year based on reviews I was hoping for a miracle. I actually am so happy with Alcester health centre. I actually feel important.
So far, it’s only been 3 months I am happy to say they I’ve felt heard, I’ve felt cared for, I’ve felt like I matter rather than ‘her again’.

Unfortunately I do have a number of issues and it means multiple appointments or one long appointment to get what I need, skin to eyes to bowel to system falling apart. Obviously it has meant previously I’ve called almost daily to a cream of this, a drop of that, an issue with this.

However since joining Alcester I’ve been given time, I’ve been given empathy from staff. They’ve listened they have understood. They have actually heard me. It’s like how the GO was 20 years ago.
My previous gp genuinely made me feel crazy, I’d lost trust in the NHS, I felt so crazy I went to counselling and I am obviously not quite over that. Medically I’m absolutely blinking insane and I blame my last GP. Because if medically trained people wouldn’t advocate for me then I had too and I wasn’t being heard. So to impress me, Alcester Health Centre had to be something special.

However if the anxiety scale was on 9, since joining this surgery I’m at 3.. I can’t change my body or my health issues but when something is wrong you want to be heard not left in a panic with Google.

Since joining this surgery I have found out I need a new drug. I am nearly pre diabetic, my cholesterol isn’t fantastic that’s just the basics. I stranded for a those issue and the doctor looked at my face and said you need a cream for that.. I thought I’d need another appointment. It’s like common sense actually exists.

With your GP you need to have a sense of it’s all in hand and my care and health matter, I’ve never had that. Suddenly I feel that someone medical care.

I don’t want everyone to join the surgery as I don’t want them inundated with patients but they do deserve more than 5* for simply the fact all staff I’ve seen have been a pleasure and they have made me feel something I haven’t felt before.. important

Lovely surgery, clean, seems to function well, nice well stocked pharmacy again lovely staff. Nice big carpark with lovely well manicured
